name: After dark: the central drop
offerText: You did well. There is another night job waiting.
description: Dusan admits he is a smuggler. Retrieve a sealed ledger from the new crate near the shop in Center at night, then return it to him. He says nobody will notice if something small disappears from the factory warehouse.

stages.description: At night, collect the Sealed ledger from the crate near Center's shop.
Return to Dusan Markovic and hand over the Sealed ledger.

_codex.narrativeIntent: The second delivery suggests industrial supplies are being diverted through unofficial routes.
